message: 司書代理

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, heading to the library again today?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, pretty much.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jeez, you sure are dedicated~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I understand your concern regarding Re-Crea, but it is a futile struggle.」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't come crying to me if you neglect your studies and bomb your tests.」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now. I think it's something we'll need to know eventually, anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「I just want to research it until I'm satisfied, at least.」

name: Synn
message: 「I plan on calling it quits before going too overboard.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, okay. Well, don't work too hard.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」
For the past few days, researching Re-Crea at the library had become my daily routine.
That said, I'd barely made any progress.
Though half the reason was really just to see Melilot-san and get treated to some tea.

name: Synn
message: 「Now then...」
I look around for Melilot-san to say hello before using the library.

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, if it isn't Synn-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san...? What on earth are you doing in the library?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh dear, do I look like I'm throwing a banquet?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I wouldn't say you don't.」

name: Helena
message: 「Jeez, how rude. I'm filling in for Melilot and doing librarian work.」

name: Synn
message: 「Filling in... Is Melilot-san off today?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, that's right.」

name: Helena
message: 「Pulling double duty as chairwoman and librarian since this morning has worn me right out...」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan, would you mind giving my shoulders a quick massage?」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, um...」
Before I can even finish saying that, Helena-san takes a seat on a nearby chair.

name: Helena
message: 「No need to hold back. Go ahead and give it everything you've got.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sigh... Well then, excuse me...」
I run my fingers over her slender, supple shoulders and gradually apply pressure.

name: Helena
message: 「Aaaahn.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek! I'm sorry!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu... My, Synn-chan, you've got quite the way with your fingers...」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-thank you...」

name: Helena
message: 「Come now, feel free to pleasure me even more...」

name: Synn
message: 「U-umm, like this...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Ahaa, that feels so good...」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes... Like you're licking me all over, hotter, and harder.」

name: Helena
message: 「Haaahn, not there, ohh...」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, it feels so good I'm going to lose my mind, Synn-chan...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Your shoulders aren't really stiff at all, are they.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, really? I didn't think that was the case...」
She reluctantly stands up from the chair.

name: Helena
message: 「Nnn~~... haa.」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, my body feels so much lighter. Thank you, Synn-chan.」

name: Helena
message: 「At this rate, doing a handstand lap around the neighborhood would be a piece of cake!」

name: Synn
message: 「What kind of punishment game is that...」
Though with Helena-san, I get the feeling she'd actually pull it off without breaking a sweat.

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, why is Melilot-san off today?」

name: Helena
message: 「Ah. Apparently she went back to her parents' house this morning.」

name: Synn
message: 「Her parents' house? You mean...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Doesn't it mean exactly what it sounds like?」

name: Synn
message: 「Right...」
I don't know anything about Melilot-san's private life, and I can't even imagine it.
After all, I only ever see her here in this library...

name: Helena
message: 「All right then, now that I've recovered from my fatigue, I suppose I'll push through a little more.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, Helena-san.」

name: Helena
message: 「What?」

name: Synn
message: 「Does the chairwoman have a lot of free time?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, are you picking a fight with me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, no, no, that's not it!」

name: Synn
message: 「I was just wondering if you aren't busy, covering for Melilot-san on top of everything else.」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, to be frank, I'd love for someone to take over for me.」

name: Helena
message: 「I only took this on because of how close Melilot and I are, you know.」

name: Helena
message: 「Plus, the library committee kid is off today too.」

name: Helena
message: 「Thanks to that, I haven't gotten to grope Ria's boobs even once since this morning...」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's alright with you, how about I fill in as a substitute.」

name: Helena
message: 「My, my. I understand how you feel, Synn-chan, I reaaally do, but.」

name: Helena
message: 「I can't just let you grope Ria's boobs so easily...」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not what I meant!」

name: Synn
message: 「I was asking if you'd let me fill in as the substitute librarian.」

name: Helena
message: 「You don't mind, Synn-chan?」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san always takes good care of me, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「As Student Council president, if there's anything I can help out with, I want to pitch in.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, aren't you quite reliable.」

name: Helena
message: 「Do you know what the job entails?」

name: Synn
message: 「I've watched Melilot do it all the time, so I have the general gist of it.」

name: Helena
message: 「Is that so. Then I think I'll take you up on your kind offer♪」

name: Helena
message: 「My work as Chairwoman happens to be piling up right now~.」

name: Synn
message: 「What's with those lewd hand gestures...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Don't sweat the small stuff! I'll leave the rest to you, Student Council President!」
And so.
I ended up taking over the duties of acting librarian from Helena.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord. Can you even handle librarian work?」

name: Synn
message: 「Shh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Chattering in the library is strictly prohibited.」
Touching the book organization carelessly seems like it'd end in disaster, so...
For now, let's patrol the library while looking for books that might give us some clues.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, welcome~.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you doing...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I was asked to fill in as acting librarian. Covering for Melilot.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's that about. Weren't you investigating Re-Crea?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm doing that at the same time. What brings you here, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, how should I put it, I was just thinking it didn't feel right leaving everything entirely up to you~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So I figured I'd drop by to check on things.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Sorry to make you worry.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, don't mention it, don't mention it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, I figured there might be a chance for us to be alone together or something...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm, did you say something?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, it's nothing!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, what's with all the commotion in the library?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, that's right.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, why are you even here, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's not like I... I just can't let Sakura-kun hog all the credit for himself, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's why I came to research Re-Crea too. That's all there is to it!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Sorry for the trouble.」

name: Misa
message: 「Seriously, good grief...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Vice President sure isn't very honest. That's what you call a contrarian.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh~ Looks like there wasn't anything to worry about after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Lolotte and even Ria-senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「I heard about it from my big sister and came to check on things, but...」

name: Ria
message: 「Looks like everyone had the exact same idea.\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I merely happened to drop by while out exploring, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're one to talk, Loro-chan.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, whatever could you mean...」

name: Misa
message: 「Come on, let's find a clue about Re-Crea before Sakura-kun does!」

name: Synn
message: 「Keep it down, please.」

name: Misa
message: 「Grr... I know that!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe... You're really looking the part.」

name: Synn
message: 「Haha... Thanks.」
I spend the rest of after-school in the library with the Student Council members, who had all gathered together before I knew it.
Perhaps because the atmosphere is different from usual, it doesn't feel like long at all until closing time.

name: Melilot
message: 「...It seems you are all gathered together again.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, Melilot-san...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Weren't you supposed to have the day off?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I just got back a moment ago.」

name: Melilot
message: 「My errands today only took a single day.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so...」
I wonder if Melilot-san's family home is near Ryuusei Town...?

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, and well, as for what's going on here...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I already heard everything from Helena.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Thank you for your hard work filling in as acting librarian.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, not at all... I really didn't do much.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even so, it was a big help.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh... yes!」
I didn't really do anything worth bragging about, though.
Even so, being thanked by Melilot-san made me feel just a little bit proud.
